advisory.situation: CRITICAL at 70s in Gate Throat. 70 people tracked; peak local density 6.53 persons/m2; mean speed 1.12 m/s; crowd pressure 4.921 s^-2. Fused risk 0.97 (high). Over the last 60s: density 5.5 to 6.5 persons/m2 (+19%); mean speed 1.13 to 1.12 m/s (-1%); occupancy 72 to 70 (-2).
advisory.mechanism: Crowd turbulence: local density x velocity variance exceeds the Helbing critical pressure, producing involuntary lateral displacement. This is the mechanism of the Mina and Love Parade disasters.
advisory.root_cause: Turbulent Surge detected at confidence 0.83. Measured evidence: stop-and-go oscillation index 0.40; pressure 4.9208 above Helbing warning level 1.200; supporting density 6.53/m2.
actions: SAFETY OFFICER: stop all inflow to Gate Throat immediately at Approach; the crowd is already in the turbulent regime.
MARSHALS: enter from the DOWNSTREAM side and break the wave laterally in sections. Assemble at Gate Throat downstream side.
CONTROL: open every available egress route to bleed pressure out of the block. Divert to Discharge.
PA: give one clear, calm, repeated instruction -- conflicting messages amplify the wave.
advisory.do_not: Do NOT push responders against the flow -- enter from the downstream side of the wave.
advisory.broadcast: Please stop moving forward and hold your position. Staff are opening additional exits now. Move only when a marshal directs you.
advisory.time_budget: On the current trend, CRITICAL is reached in about 0s. WARNING: the recommended action needs about 45s to take effect, which is 45s LONGER than the time available. Escalate one level immediately and act on the faster intervention.
advisory.notify_role: Safety officer, medical lead, and all marshals
